pattern: each player with fewer cards in hand than the player with the most cards in hand draws cards equal to the difference
subject: none

examples.text: Each player with fewer cards in hand than the player with the most cards in hand draws cards equal to the difference. You gain 2 life.
Each player with fewer cards in hand than the player with the most cards in hand draws cards equal to the difference. Scry 2.

counterExamples: Each player with fewer cards in hand than the player with the most cards in hand draws a card.
Each player with fewer cards in hand than you draws cards equal to the difference.
Each player with more cards in hand than the player with the fewest cards in hand discards cards equal to the difference.

pattern: {p:Player} reveal[s] {o:ChosenCard} , put[s] {o2:ChosenCard} on the bottom of their library , then draw[s] {n:Qty} card[s]
subject: player

examples.text: Look at target player's hand. You may choose a nonland card from it. If you do, that player reveals the chosen card, puts it on the bottom of their library, then draws a card.
Target opponent reveals their hand. You choose a creature card from it. That player reveals that card, puts it on the bottom of their library, then draws two cards.

counterExamples: Look at target player's hand. You may choose a nonland card from it. If you do, that player reveals the chosen card, puts it on top of their library, then draws a card.
Look at target player's hand. You may choose a nonland card from it. If you do, that player reveals the chosen card, puts it on the bottom of their library, then you draw a card.
Look at target player's hand. You may choose a nonland card from it. If you do, that player reveals the chosen card, puts it on the bottom of their library, then mills a card.

pattern: each opponent with no cards in hand loses {n:Qty} life
subject: none

examples.text: Each opponent with no cards in hand loses 3 life. You gain 3 life.
Each opponent with no cards in hand loses 10 life. Scry 1.

counterExamples: Each opponent with no cards in hand loses 3 life unless you pay {1}.
Each player with no cards in hand loses 3 life.
Each opponent with one or fewer cards in hand loses 3 life.

pattern: choose {n:Qty} cards in your hand and discard the rest
subject: none

examples.text: Draw three cards, then choose two cards in your hand and discard the rest.
Choose three cards in your hand and discard the rest. You gain 1 life.

counterExamples: Draw three cards, then choose two cards in your hand and exile the rest.
Draw three cards, then choose two cards in target player's hand and discard the rest.
Draw three cards, then choose two cards in your hand and discard them.
